entries.back_en: "I didn't know what to think when I received word from Ludia that you had been captured."
"How should I think? My daughter goes out in search of her missing sister, only to be caught invading enemy territory... How did this happen?"
entries.note: 'Como eu deveria pensar?' = 'How should I think?'; loses 'What was I supposed to think?' meaning.

entries.back_en: "I beg your forgiveness, Majesty. It's all my fault. If it weren't for me..."
"As you have probably already discovered for yourself, our neighbor and supposed ally Ludia is more worried about its relations with the Empire than helping me search for my daughter."
"So, what do you intend to do now? Sooner or later, the Ludians will surely discover you are here. We will do everything we can to protect you..."
"I see... But... Even though I am king of Wyndia, I have no control over the dragon... You know that."
entries.note: 'Eu vejo' is literal; should be 'Entendo' for 'I see'.

entries.back_en: "Hmm... I see... Very well. Go to the woods east of here. There you will find the Oracle of Wind, a priestess who serves the Wind Dragon."
"I will let her know you are coming. Rest tonight--you can begin your journey in the morning."
The King has been put in a very difficult position... On one hand he has to protect his daughter, Princess [04], and on the other he has to maintain our relations with Ludia.
I pity the poor King... Although he is more worried about Princess Elina than anyone, he does not discuss the matter with anyone in public. It hurts my heart to look at him...
The [09][07][05] is an ancient holy relic, needed to enter the Tower of Wind, which is sacred to the Wind Dragon. It is kept in a safe place beneath the castle.
We have reports that Ludian troops have been seen near the castle. You must hurry, before they find out you are here!
Princess Elina is engaged to marry the Prince of Ludia... Princess [04] is next in line to the throne... Which should I choose--a love that is wrong, or a love that cannot be?
Wait... If Princess [04] and I join together, that means one day I will be King of Wyndia... Will I be able to handle the responsibility?
If I marry Princess Elina, that means the entire country of Ludia will be after us... Will I be able to protect her from them?
"Hmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? I understand now why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck."
"Hmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? I understand now why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck."
"[04]... There is little I can do for you now. You have grown much, my daughter. You are strong enough to fight your own battles now. I am very proud of you!"
Please take good care of Princess [04]!
Indeed, Princess [04]! For a moment, I almost mistook you for your sister. You have grown much in recent time--more confident, more mature. If only she were here to see you now!
Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha! Look at the people down there! They look like ants! Insects! Bwah ha ha ha ha!
Who are you?
I pay little attention to what doesn't affect Wyndia, but even I can see that the world is changing...
